cut: v2 (owner, 18 Oct: 'messaging too unclear') — one comparison, three facts
argument: A toaster's safety standard requires a backup off switch; the most powerful AI models have no such rule in the US, and California's 'kill switch' is still only a study.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: Which has a backup off switch: / your toaster, / or the most powerful [AI]?
text.fi: Kummassa on varakatkaisin: / leivänpaahtimessa / vai tehokkaimmassa / [tekoälyssä]?
text.ja: 予備の 停止スイッチが あるのは / トースター？ それとも 最強の [AI]？

captions.source: The station's question; the comparison is ours, not any interviewee's.

text.en: The toaster. / Its US safety standard requires / a [second] off switch.
text.fi: Leivänpaahtimessa. / Sen yhdysvaltalainen / standardi vaatii / [toisen] katkaisimen.
text.ja: トースター。 米国の 安全規格は / [2つ目の] 停止スイッチを 義務づける。

captions.source: UL 1026 (household cooking appliances, toasters included): the 6th-edition revisions added a redundant control and a secondary operating control for cord-connected automatic toasters (InCompliance; Intertek). UL listing is voluntary in law but near-universal.

text.en: The most powerful AI models? / US federal rules are [voluntary].
text.ja: 最強の AIモデルは？ / 米連邦の ルールは [任意]。

captions.source: EO 14409 (2 June 2026) asks frontier developers for up to 30 days' early access and authorises no mandatory licensing or preclearance (CNBC; Crowell; WilmerHale; CRS IF13268). No federal statute requires pre-release testing (law-firm readings, June 2026). Binding rules exist elsewhere (California SB 53 incident reporting; EU AI Act Art. 55), hence 'US federal'.

text.en: California's AI "kill switch"? / Still a [study], due 16 November.
text.ja: カリフォルニアの / AI「キルスイッチ」は？ / まだ [調査中]。 期限は 11月16日。

captions.source: Executive Order N-9-26, 18 Sept 2026, asks experts to recommend changes to state AI law, including a frontier-model 'kill switch', by 16 Nov (governor's office; CalMatters; CNN; CNBC). A study and recommendations, not a mandate.

text.en: The toaster's off switch / has a backup. / The AI's is a [sticky note].
text.fi: Leivänpaahtimen katkaisimella / on varakatkaisin. / Tekoälyn katkaisin / on [muistilappu].
text.ja: トースターの 停止スイッチには / 予備が ある。 / AIのは [付箋]。

captions.source: The station's line, over its own image (the kill switch drawn on a sticky note).

post.en: Your toaster's safety standard requires a backup off switch. The most powerful AI models? US federal rules are voluntary, and California's "kill switch" is still a study, due 16 November. Who decides when AI gets an off switch? #AI #AIsafety #California
post.fi: Leivänpaahtimen turvastandardi vaatii varakatkaisimen. Tehokkaimmat tekoälymallit? Liittovaltion säännöt ovat vapaaehtoisia, ja Kalifornian "hätäkatkaisin" on yhä selvitys, määräaika 16.11. Kuka päättää, milloin tekoäly saa katkaisimen?
post.ja: トースターの安全規格は予備の停止スイッチを義務づける。最強のAIモデルは？米連邦のルールは任意、カリフォルニアの「キルスイッチ」はまだ調査中で、期限は11月16日。AIの停止スイッチは誰が決める？
